description: Update one manual step outcome inside an Xray Test Run. The Test Run is resolved from a Test Execution key and Test key, and stepNumber uses one-based ordering.

actualResult.description: The observed result. An empty string clears the existing value.

comment.description: The execution comment. An empty string clears the existing value.

executionKey.description: The Jira issue key of the Test Execution that owns the Test Run.

iterationRank.description: Optional Xray data-set iteration rank. Omit it for an ordinary manual Test Run.

status.description: The Xray Test Run Step status name or identifier.

stepNumber.description: The one-based manual step number selected from the Test Run.

testKey.description: The Jira issue key of the Test represented by the Test Run.

name: update_xray_execution_step

actualResult.description: The actual result applied to the Test Run Step.

comment.description: The comment applied to the Test Run Step.

executionId.description: The numeric Jira issue identifier of the Test Execution.

executionKey.description: The resolved Jira issue key of the Test Execution.

error.description: The actionable root failure returned when the Test Run Step update fails.

iterationRank.description: The Xray data-set iteration rank used for the update.

message.description: A stable summary returned when the Test Run Step update fails.

status.description: The status applied to the Test Run Step.

stepId.description: The opaque Xray identifier of the updated Test Run Step.

stepNumber.description: The one-based manual step number selected by the caller.

testId.description: The numeric Jira issue identifier of the Test.

testKey.description: The resolved Jira issue key of the Test.

testRunId.description: The opaque Xray identifier of the Test Run.
